description: US.ElectricityNetwork is a dataset listed in Geodata Portal Sweden, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geo-inspire.trafikverket.se. The Swedish Transport Administration is responsible for supply lines intended exclusively for the operation of railways. The dataset covers approximately half of the total network managed by the Transport Administration. Supply lines 32 and 132 kV. Coverage: SE. Its keywords include Allmännyttiga och offentliga tjänster. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geodata-se.
